tools.name: search_perfumes
tools.description: Search the parfum1 catalogue by words in the perfume name, house or scent family (all words must match, accents ignored), optionally within one house. Returns a page of perfumes in popularity order with the starting price, stock, rating and product URL.

tools.name: get_perfume
tools.description: Read one perfume by its handle: name, house, description, top, heart and base notes, and every size (3, 10 and 30 ml) with the price, the struck regular price, price per ml and whether it is in stock, exactly as the product page shows them, plus the full bottle (listed out of stock) and the product

tools.name: list_houses
tools.description: List the perfume houses in the catalogue, A to Z, with their handle, whether the house is a niche house, the number of perfumes and the house page URL. Optionally filter by words in the house name.

tools.name: get_house
tools.description: Read one perfume house by its handle: its introduction, the number of perfumes and the first 50 of them with starting price and stock. Use search_perfumes with the house for the rest.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Read how parfum1 works, with the same facts as its help pages: delivery (dispatch, cost, countries), returns, payment methods and contact details. Pass a topic for one, or none for all four.
